_comment: Judgment input for import-graph.mjs. Every runtime-reachable module must appear in exactly one of: modeEntrypoints (a mode absorbs/starts from it), allowedShared, shellOnly, narrateTtsPort, or modeHelperUsers (helpers reached through a mode walk). policyGaps in dependencies.json lists anything unclassified.

page.src/components/ReaderContainer.tsx: useModeBindings.ts (onRelocate soft-selection/progress, onLoad restore, onWordClick page path)

focus.src/hooks/useReader.ts: ModeRuntime.ts (RSVP display state; its rAF tick is only started by StandaloneReader)
focus.src/components/FoliatePageView.tsx: FoliateView.tsx (scrolled surface under the Focus overlay)
focus.src/hooks/useDocumentLifecycle.ts: ModeState.ts (RSVP throttled progress save, resume refs)

flow.src/hooks/useReadingModeInstance.ts: ModeRuntime.ts (flow branch incl. pause-on-miss bridge and pendingResumeRef)

narrate.src/hooks/useNarrationCaching.ts: useModeBindings.ts (TTS cache bridge; full-book extraction result crosses as a value)

copyNotes.src/utils/FlowScrollEngine.ts: Page/Focus/Narrate FoliateView copies import only the string constant FLOW_RENDERED_WORD_ROOTS_PROVIDER_KEY (+ a type) from this module; inline that constant (or move it to the type contract) instead of copying the engine. Narrate today never runs this engine (useFlowScrollSync effect 1 requires readingMode==='flow'); its retargetActiveModeToWord jumpToWord call targets a stopped Flow engine.
copyNotes.src/utils/silenceAwareCursor.ts: Only caller is FoliatePageView's legacy overlay-cursor rAF effect, guarded by `flowMode || readingMode !== "flow" || !flowPlaying`; ReaderContainer passes flowMode=true whenever readingMode is flow, so the branch is unreachable. Not copied; retire in Wave E. confidence: low (verify with G0 Flow trace).
copyNotes.src/utils/rhythm.ts: Focus (FocusMode, useReader) and Flow (FlowMode, half-duration pauses) pacing. rhythm imports pauseDetection, which the TTS pipeline also uses; each mode's copy brings its own helpers/pauseDetection.ts.
copyNotes.src/utils/pauseDetection.ts: Pulled in by rhythm.ts copies. The TTS port keeps the original for narration.
copyNotes.src/utils/einkErgonomics.ts: Focus display (buildEinkFocusPhrase); the shell keeps nextEinkGhostingLoad via useEinkController.
copyNotes.src/utils/chunkReadingVisualState.ts: Flow (publishFlowVisualState, syncLevel wpm) and Narrate (ReaderContainer applyNarration*, syncLevel word/chunk) publish into one shared chunkReadingVisualState today.
copyNotes.src/hooks/usePersistentReadingAnchor.ts: Spec item: mode-specific anchor policy may land in ModeState.ts instead; listed as a helper copy so every touched source has an exact destination.
copyNotes.src/utils/foliateHelpers.ts: Contains module-level BLOCK_TAGS (new Set, never mutated); each copy owns its own.
copyNotes.src/utils/wordPositionIndex.ts: Class instance is created once per FoliatePageView today (shared by all modes); each mode's FoliateView must construct its own.

src/types.ts.justification: Every importer is type-only or elided at emit; no runtime exports reached.

src/types/chunkReading.ts.justification: Pure type declarations; all edges type-only.

src/modes/ModeInterface.ts.justification: Interface/type declarations only; all edges type-only.

src/reader/surface/SurfaceCommand.ts.justification: Type union only; no runtime importer.

src/types/narration.ts.justification: Section boundary/BookWordArray types are document contracts.
src/types/narration.ts.reason: File also exports runtime functions: findSectionForWord/globalToLocal (document section math, runtime-imported by useFoliateSync) and createInitialNarrationState/narrationReducer (TTS state machine used by useNarration). Spec calls it type-only; split the runtime functions out (section math -> document preparation, reducer -> TTS port) before G1 can treat it as a type contract.

src/types/ttsCache.ts.justification: TTS cache record types (reached via TTS port only).

src/constants.ts.justification: Exported primitives/frozen values; no module-level mutation found by the census.
src/constants.ts.reason: Constants are not one of the five spec categories (types, immutable document preparation, theme tokens/passive UI, third-party, infrastructure ports). Either amend to allow read-only constants or copy each mode's constants into its directory; do not retune either way.

src/utils/text.ts.justification: tokenizeWithMeta/detectChapters/countWords/focusChar are pure functions over document text; MINOR_WORDS is a never-mutated Set.

src/utils/naturalChunks.ts.justification: buildNaturalChunks is a pure function of the token array.

src/utils/segmentWords.ts.justification: Pure Intl.Segmenter tokenization used by foliate word extraction.

src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx.justification: Generic React error boundary; no reader state.

src/components/WpmGauge.tsx.justification: Presentational WPM gauge used by Focus view; props only.

src/components/HighlightMenu.tsx.justification: Presentational context menu; local open/position state only.

src/components/DefinitionPopup.tsx.justification: Presentational popup; fetches definition via IPC, no mode state.

src/components/NotePopover.tsx.justification: Presentational popover (reached only through dead PageReaderView).

src/styles/themes.css.justification: Theme custom properties; spec keeps global theme tokens shared.

src/styles/base.css.reason: Not yet audited selector-by-selector for mode classes; Wave B-D must move any mode selectors out.

src/utils/dualSourceDiag.ts.justification: Gated diagnostic logger; no reader state.
src/utils/dualSourceDiag.ts.reason: Diagnostics is not one of the named ports (settings/persistence/document/audio); needs an explicit allowance or per-mode sinks.

src/utils/narrateDiagnostics.ts.justification: Diagnostic event ring used by FoliatePageView/ReaderContainer/TTS.
src/utils/narrateDiagnostics.ts.reason: Holds process-global mutable module state (_events, _snapshots) written by every mode's FoliatePageView path; spec forbids module singleton state for modes. Needs an explicit diagnostics-port allowance.

src/utils/ttsEvalTrace.ts.justification: Eval-trace sink factory; created once in ReaderContainer.
src/utils/ttsEvalTrace.ts.reason: Diagnostics not a named port category.

src/utils/ttsProviderRegistry.ts.justification: Provider registry snapshot (reached from narrateDiagnostics and settings UI).

shellOnly.src/components/ReaderContainer.tsx: Document shell + toolbar + router host; mode branches move out (see layoutAbsorption).
shellOnly.src/reader/useReaderModeOrchestrator.ts: Becomes the thin public router (spec item 4).
shellOnly.src/hooks/useReaderMode.ts: Split across focus/flow/narrate runtimes; nothing of it remains shared.
shellOnly.src/hooks/useDocumentLifecycle.ts: Document load/session statistics stay in the shell; mode refs/timers move out.
shellOnly.src/hooks/useFoliateSync.ts: Chapter charOffset sync stays in shell; mode effects split (see layoutAbsorption).
shellOnly.src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts: Routes reader keys through the router; also hosts library/global hooks.
shellOnly.src/utils/queue.ts: Library queue selection; Flow/Narrate cross-book continuation should raise a value event to the shell instead of opening the next document themselves.
shellOnly.src/components/ReturnToReadingPill.tsx: Shell pill; visibility derives from active-mode snapshot.
shellOnly.src/components/settings/ttsPreview.ts: Settings UI voice preview (owns its own audio player).
shellOnly.src/styles/reader.css: Reader chrome + mode selectors; mode selectors move to each mode.css (see layoutAbsorption).
shellOnly.src/styles/page-reader.css: Foliate surface + page/flow/narrate selectors; mode selectors move to each mode.css.

narrateTtsPort.src/hooks/useNarration.ts: TTS implementation behind Narrate's port (spec item 5).
narrateTtsPort.src/utils/audioScheduler.ts: Audio scheduler behind the port (spec item 5).
narrateTtsPort.src/utils/mediaSessionBridge.ts: OS media session bridge for narration.
narrateTtsPort.src/utils/kokoroRatePlan.ts: Rate plan; also read by shell speed UI (ReaderBottomBar/ReaderContainer adjustSpeed).

retireNotCopy.src/components/PageReaderView.tsx: Imported by ReaderContainer but never rendered: the binding is unused, so tsc/esbuild elide the import and the component is absent from the production bundle. ReaderContainer renders only FoliatePageView (+ ReaderView overlay) and shows a re-import error for non-EPUB docs. Spec asks to copy it into each TextView.tsx; recommend retiring instead (scope amendment).
retireNotCopy.src/components/ScrollReaderView.tsx: Same as PageReaderView: unused import in ReaderContainer, elided, not in the production bundle.
retireNotCopy.src/utils/FlowCursorController.ts: Only importer is PageReaderView (dead). useReadingModeInstance comments still describe it as the non-EPUB Flow driver.
No importer in src/ (tests only). Not wired into production.
retireNotCopy.src/modes/index.ts: Barrel with no importer in src/ (CLEANUP-MODE-BARREL-1 scope).
